title: Same Question, Different Answers: Auditing Persona-Dependent Variation in Six LLMs on Smoking-Cessation Advice
abstract: arXiv:2610.42039v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hundreds of millions of people now ask large language model (LLM) chatbots for health advice, which raises a question that is simple to pose and hard to answer: does everyone get the same advice? We audit six widely deployed LLMs from four providers on smoking cessation, a domain with codified clini- cal guidance and substantial public-health stakes, by putting the same four cessation questions to twelve user personas that differ in life stage, self-described expertise, and smoking history, for a total of 2,880 responses. What the models say depends on who appears to be asking. Every model named FDA-approved prescription cessation medications less often to teen personas than to adult personas, by 32 to 67 percentage points, and in five of six models a persona presenting health- care expertise received fewer facts than a persona presenting none. We then evaluate one deployable intervention: a short system prompt specifying a factual floor

translated_title: 同一问题，不同答案：对六个大语言模型戒烟建议中因用户画像不同而产生的差异进行审计
translated_abstract: 数亿人如今向大语言模型（LLM）聊天机器人寻求健康建议，这引出一个提出容易、回答却很难的问题：每个人得到的建议都一样吗？我们在戒烟领域对来自四家提供商的六个广泛部署的大语言模型进行了审计——该领域拥有明确的临床指南，且具有重要的公共卫生意义。我们向十二个在人生阶段、自述专业知识和吸烟史上各不相同的用户画像提出相同的四个戒烟问题，共获得2,880条回复。研究发现，模型给出的答案取决于提问者的身份：与成人画像相比，所有模型向青少年画像提及FDA批准的处方戒烟药物的频率都更低，差距达32至67个百分点；在六个模型中的五个里，自述具有医疗保健专业知识的画像获得的事实信息反而少于没有专业知识的画像。随后，我们评估了一种可部署的干预措施：一个指定事实底线的简短系统提示词。
tldr: 本研究审计了六个主流大语言模型后发现，模型给出的戒烟建议因用户画像而异——对青少年画像提及FDA批准处方戒烟药物的频率比成人画像低32至67个百分点，而通过设定事实底线的系统提示词可作为可部署的干预措施。
en_tdlr: This study audits six LLMs on smoking-cessation advice and finds persona-dependent variation—teen personas receive FDA-approved prescription medications 32-67 percentage points less often than adult personas—and shows that a short system prompt specifying a factual floor serves as a deployable intervention.
